prompts.introduction: You will complete several cinematography tasks. There are no correct answers. Please describe what you intend as naturally as possible. Do not try to write a professional prompt.
prompts.t1: There is no sketch and no AI assistance. Describe the shot as naturally as possible.
prompts.direct_refine: Look at your earlier description. There is still no sketch. Describe the shot again as clearly as possible.
prompts.sketch_refine: Based on your sketch, please describe your intended shot again as clearly as possible. Use your own words.
prompts.transfer: This is a new task. There is no sketch and no assistance. Describe the shot as clearly as possible.
